tasks.label: Build & Run ExoCortex (macOS)
tasks.command: pkill -x ExoCortex 2>/dev/null; xcodebuild -project ExoCortex.xcodeproj -scheme ExoCortex -destination 'platform=macOS' -configuration Debug build && open ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/ExoCortex-*/Build/Products/Debug/ExoCortex.app

tasks.label: Build & Run ExoCortex (iPhone Simulator)
tasks.command: xcrun simctl boot 'iPhone 16 Pro' 2>/dev/null || true; xcodebuild -project ExoCortex.xcodeproj -scheme ExoCortex -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' -configuration Debug build && xcrun simctl install booted ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/ExoCortex-*/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/ExoCortex.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.s9f.ExoCortex && open -a Simulator
